examples.text: Bei der Pressekonferenz verblüfft er die Reporter mit einem Geständnis.
Die Tänzerin weiß mit der Beweglichkeit ihrer Gliedmaßen zu verblüffen.
Ich verblüffte meinen Gegner mit einem geschickten Zug.

glosses: Deflector, bafle.
Confundir, desconcertar.
Frustrar.
Amortiguar, contener, regular.
şaşırtmak
（声音、光、液体等的）反射板，挡板

examples.text: sound baffle
Tanker trucks use baffles to keep the liquids inside from sloshing around.

glosses: （困惑敌人用的）障壁
卷扬机的节流阀控制杆
使...困惑，使...不解，迷惑

examples.text: I am baffled by the contradictions and omissions in the instructions.
examples.translation: 指示里的自相矛盾和疏漏让我一头雾水。

glosses: 无谓地挣扎

examples.text: A ship baffles with the winds.

glosses: 制止，阻止，挫败

examples.text: the art that baffles time's tyrannic claim

It may have been the failure of Christianity to emancipate itself from expiatory theories of moral responsibility, guilt, innocence, reward, punishment, and the rest of it, that baffled its intention of changing the world.

So they had to search the world again for a sphinx. And still there was none. But they were not men that it is easy to baffle, and at last they found a sphinx in a desert at evening watching a ruined temple whose gods she had eaten hundreds of years ago when her hunger was on her.

glosses: 当众羞辱 （尤指骑士）

examples.text: He by the heeles him hung upon a tree, / And baffuld so, that all which passed by / The picture of his punishment might see […].

glosses: 欺骗

examples.text: pretences to baffle with his goodness
